patch_description: Add a modest reward for selected two-hop paths, but discount it when the intermediate node has high total traffic or either path link already serves substantial direct demand. This uses the limited in/out degree as a rough indicator of transit congestion, so it is more selective than a uniform two-hop reward. The number of quadratic terms is at most n(n−1)(n−2), within the stated limit. The existing direct-demand reward and degree penalty are retained.
